explication: Neovim is a modal text editor whose main workflow is opening and editing files through its command-line application, then presenting the result through a terminal or attached UI. Its documented capabilities also include a programmable API, Vimscript and Lua, embedded terminals, asynchronous jobs, and shared shada data. The tree identifies the major implementation areas, but sampled source is incomplete; edges are limited to README-documented relationships or marked unverified where wiring was not shown.
